items.label: Single-storey flat roof garden room
items.text: Single-storey rectangular garden building with a flat roof featuring a prominent, deep projecting overhang and thick dark fascia along the front and side.

items.label: Exterior materials and finishes
items.text: Vertical dark brown/charred timber cladding boards across the front and right visible elevations; flat matte dark charcoal/black roof fascia; thin black aluminium window and door frames.

items.label: Front horizontal ribbon window
items.text: A wide, horizontally oriented rectangular fixed/awning window set into the upper-left section of the front facade, featuring clear glass, a slim projecting sill, and a black frame.

items.label: Front three-leaf glazed sliding doors
items.text: Full-height three-panel glazed sliding glass door set occupying the right half of the front facade, with minimalist black frames running floor-to-ceiling.

items.label: Charcoal timber decking
items.text: Extensive dark grey/charcoal timber decking with wide horizontal boards running in front of and alongside the building, featuring a recessed rectangular cut-out on the right exposing a green lawn or tiled patch.

items.label: Left-side external steps
items.text: Tiered dark grey steps rising adjacent to the left corner of the building leading towards the rear.

items.label: Rear boundary brick wall
items.text: Light buff/sand-coloured brick masonry boundary wall visible standing behind the building on both the left and right sides.

items.label: Exterior up/down wall sconces
items.text: Three slim rectangular black up-and-down exterior wall lights mounted to the front facade: one left of the window, one between the window and doors, and one to the right of the glazed doors, casting warm light cones.

items.label: Roof overhang soffit spotlights
items.text: A continuous line of circular recessed warm downlights integrated into the underside of the projecting front roof soffit.

items.label: Furnished studio interior
items.text: Interior visible through the glazing features light natural wood flooring, smooth white walls, two contemporary white armchairs, an internal light timber door, and a dark grey kitchenette unit with a sink, tall faucet, and overhead wall cabinet.
